title: XDRIP not able to communicate with MiaoMiao
body:
I have Samsung s9+ with Libre sensor and attached to that MiaoMiao.
Everything worked fine till I left my phone to charge and departed from the phone so there was no reception from the MiaoMiao because of the distance. 
I returned after an hour or so and Xdrip would not be able to communicate with MiaoMiao and get the Libre readings.

comments.body:
I use MM2 and a xiaomi under Android 6, which is quite restrictive in power saving mode, although I included Xdrip and BT in "not optimized" and never killing the service in background. 
However, it's true that at least MM2 may have some problems to reconnect. 
What I do is to enable GPS, go to scan bluetooth and click again in the MM2. Sometimes I need to disable an re-enable the BT and press "restart collector". 
Occasionally, it takes 15 minutes to reconnect. However, most of times the MM2 does it nearly immediately. It may also take a long time when restarting the phone and some other times it connects immediately, but can't say why.

So my routine is to check the state every time I go away from the collector, and do any of the mentioned above solutions in case it doesn't reconnect in 5 min. Hope it helps

@sstolero1 Would you please close this issue if it has been resolved?
